# ioNova AI

> AI-Native ISO 20022 Address Resolution and Entity Intelligence for Payments

ioNova converts unstructured payment address data into ISO 20022-compliant structured formats using AI-native address resolution. It serves banks, payment processors, and financial institutions preparing for the November 2026 SWIFT CBPR+ and SEPA structured address mandate, achieving >99% straight-through processing (STP) rates across 195 countries. The platform deploys in 10–16 weeks via sidecar architecture with no legacy system replacement required.

## Products

### Address Intelligence
The missing layer in payment infrastructure. Parse, validate, and enrich payment addresses for ISO 20022 compliance across 195 countries. Combines a deterministic Address Resolution Engine (98% of requests, <50ms P95) with an Agentic Workbench (2% of edge cases, <2 seconds) for >99% combined STP.

- [Address Intelligence Overview](https://ionova.ai/address-intelligence): Parse, validate, and enrich payment addresses for ISO 20022 SWIFT CBPR+ and SEPA compliance across 195 countries
- [Structured Address Mandate](https://ionova.ai/address-intelligence/structured-address-mandate): Meet the November 2026 ISO 20022 mandate required by SWIFT, EPC, and CPMI — TwnNm + Ctry minimum, full structured target
- [Business Value](https://ionova.ai/address-intelligence/structured-address-value): >99% STP rates, ~30% fewer sanctions false positives, $8–12B in industry-wide annual savings
- [Purpose-Built Solution](https://ionova.ai/address-intelligence/purpose-built-address-solution): Why postal validation and generic LLMs fail at payment address compliance — deterministic, auditable, 195-country coverage
- [Implementation](https://ionova.ai/address-intelligence/address-implementation): Sidecar architecture, 10–16 week timeline, zero legacy rip-and-replace, pre-built MuleSoft/Volante/Finastra/SWIFT connectors

### Entity Intelligence
Resolve entities across 50+ systems with 95%+ precision and <200ms latency. The only platform with evidence-first AI and progressive autonomy.

- [Entity Intelligence Platform](https://ionova.ai/entity-intelligence): Overview of entity resolution capabilities — 366%+ three-year ROI, 6–12 month payback
- [Evidence-First AI](https://ionova.ai/entity-intelligence/evidence): AI copilots that cite their sources with mandatory document citations, field-level confidence scores, and full decision audit trails
- [Cascade Resolution](https://ionova.ai/entity-intelligence/cascade): Reduce entity resolution costs by 90% with multi-stage cascade: exact match, fuzzy match, semantic match, LLM escalation
- [Progressive Autonomy](https://ionova.ai/entity-intelligence/autonomy): 4-level framework for governing AI agency in regulated enterprises — from read-only recommendations to full autonomy
- [Governance-by-Design](https://ionova.ai/entity-intelligence/governance): SR 11-7 and EU AI Act compliant with audit-grade evidence packs and continuous model drift monitoring
- [Overlay Deployment](https://ionova.ai/entity-intelligence/overlay): Deploy in 90 days as a read-only overlay, no data migration, no rip-and-replace
